title: Cooking juice
description: The Cooking juice mod adds several new juices and ice creams.  This mod will improve and add more variety to your cooking.
body:
The Cooking juice mod adds several new juices: apple, carrot, and beet. They can be made using a juicer. Freezing the juice in the refrigerator turns it into ice cream. Each ice cream has its own effect. This mod will improve and add more variety to your cooking.

The mod is in early development, so all mechanics and textures have been refined and improved.
